apropos.title: Noma da Haɓaka Ƙwarewa a Tsakiyar Sahel.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez wani gagarumin shiri ne mai nufin bayyana da ɗaukaka basirar matasan Nijar. Mun yi imani cewa ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire na fitowa ne daga haɗin gadonmu na al'ada da kuma fasahohin zamani.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Samun damar shiga shirye-shiryen horo na musamman don magance ƙalubalen fasaha na yanzu da na gaba.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: Muna canza tunani zuwa aiyuka na zahiri. Ta hanyar samar da kayan aiki, jagoranci da tsari mai kyau, muna taimakawa wajen kafa sabbin kamfanoni masu amfani ga al'umma.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Haɗa matasa masu basira da ƙwararrun malamai da shugabannin masana'antu don ƙulla alaƙa mai ɗorewa.
apropos.inspiration_quote: Hamada ba cikas ba ce, matattakalar ƙara fahimta da basira ce.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Gano muhimman matakan da suka kafa tarihin da tasirin OPE Agadez tun kafuwarta.
apropos.stats_mentors: Masu Ba da Horon da ke Aiki

talents.title: Gwarazan 1000 na Nijar
talents.subtitle: Gano sabbin jagorori, masu ƙirƙira da masu fasaha da ke gina kyakkyawar makomar ƙasar Nijar daga yankin Agadez zuwa ko'ina a ƙasa.
talents.search_placeholder: Nemo gwarzo, ƙwarewa, gari ko kalma...
talents.no_results: Babu wani gwarzo da ya dace da bincikenka.

categories_page.title: Rukunoninmu na Ƙwarewa (Houses)
categories_page.subtitle: Shirin OPE Agadez ya karkata ne a kan manyan ginshiƙai guda uku don bayyana da kuma ɗaukaka basirar matasan yankin.
categories_page.steam_desc: Kimiyya, Fasaha, Injiniyanci, Fasahar Zane da Lissafi. Ɗakin gwaje-gwajen fasahohin zamani.
categories_page.lp_desc: Kasuwanci da amfani da albarkatun cikin gida: aikin gona na zamani, kiwo da sana'o'in hannu na musamman.
categories_page.mcc_title: Misalin Dan Kasa Mai Kishi da Al'umma (MCC)
categories_page.mcc_desc: Kishin ƙasa, aikin gayya, tsabtar muhalli, zaman lafiya da haɗin kan al'umma.

membres.title: Ƙungiyar Masu Shiryawa
membres.subtitle: Gano fuskokin Ƙungiyar Haɓaka Ƙwarewa (OPE). Ƙungiya mai ƙwazo, mai son ƙirƙirar fasaha da ilimi don makomar matasan Agadez.

actualites.title: Labarai & Muhimman Abubuwan da ke Faruwa
actualites.subtitle: Bi diddigin ci gaban OPE Agadez: shirye-shirye, tarukan bita da kuma manyan nasarorin gwarazanmu.
actualites.newsletter_title: Kasance a Cikin Masu Samun Labarai
actualites.newsletter_desc: Sami sababbin labarai da sanarwar CNCEIZ kai tsaye a cikin akwatin imel ɗinku.

galerie.title: Dakin Hotuna da Bidiyo
galerie.subtitle: Sake kallon lokuta masu mahimmanci, tarurrukan bita da ƙarfin basirar sansanin Agadez a cikin hotuna.

contact.title: Tuntube Mu

sponsors_page.title: Abokan Hulɗa & Masu Tallafi
sponsors_page.subtitle: Gagarumin goyon bayansu shi ne ginshiƙin ciyar da ƙwarewar fasaha da ilimi gaba a Agadez. Tare muke gina makomar Sahel.
sponsors_page.cta_title: Zama Ɗaya Daga Masu Kawo Canji
sponsors_page.cta_desc: Haɗa sunan kamfaninku da babban shirin kawo sauyi a fannin zamantakewa da fasaha a Nijar. Tare, za mu ciyar da matasan Agadez gaba.
sponsors_page.become_sponsor: Zama Dan Canji a Cikin Al'umma
sponsors_page.sponsor_cta_desc: Haɗa sunan kamfaninku da babban aiki mai tasiri ga al'umma da fasaha a Nijar. Tare, za mu ciyar da matasan Agadez zuwa ga ƙwarewar zamani.

form.title: Takardar Neman Shiga CNCEIZ a Yanar Gizo
form.subtitle: Cika wannan fom ɗin don neman shiga ɗaya daga cikin Houses 3 na ƙasa.
form.step1_desc: Zaɓi babban fanni don neman shiga.
form.step2_desc: Cika dukkan bayanan ku na asali a tsanake.
form.step3_other_label: Fayyace taken aikin ku na gida *
form.step4_desc: Bayyana ayyukanku ko kudurinku ga wannan House
form.step4_status_label: Me ne halin yanzu na aikinku ? *
form.step4_placeholder_steam: Kwatanta matsalar kimiyya ko fasaha da kuke so ku warware, kayan aiki da kuke shirin amfani da su (code, injiniyanci, lantarki) da kuma manufofinku...
form.step4_placeholder_lp: Kwatanta aikin ku na gida: nau'in noma/kiwo/sana'a, tasirin tattalin arziki, bukatunki da hangen nesa...
form.step4_placeholder_mcc: Kwatanta aikin jama'a da kuka yi ko shirin yi: tasirin al'umma, tara citizensanci, sakon zaman lafiya da hadinkai...
form.step4_filiere_label: Jerin karatu ko horo da aka bi
form.step4_moyenne_label: Matsakaicin sakamakon makaranta na kwanan nan
form.step4_recommandant_label: Lambobin sadarwa na malami ko mai ba da horo mai ba da shawara (Suna & Waya)
form.step4_citoyen_recommandant: Lambobin sadarwa na mutumin da zai iya tabbatar da alkawarin ku na kasa
form.step5_desc: Faɗa mana abin da ya ba ku sha'awar shiga sansanin Agadez 2026.
form.step5_motivation_label: Me ya sa kuke son shiga CNCEIZ? Me kuke fatan kawo wa al'ummarku bayan sansanin ? *
form.step5_motivation_placeholder: Gaya mana abin da ke motsa ku, abin da kuke son koyo kusa da gwarazan 1000 da kuma yadda za ku raba nasarorin a yankinku...
form.step5_numerique_label: Kuna da damar samun wayar hannu ko kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka a lokacin sansanin? *
form.step5_num_shared_desc: Na'urar dangi ko mai ba da horo
form.step5_num_place: A'a, amma zan shirya a wurin
form.step6_title: 6. Takardu & Shaidun da za a Haɗa
form.step6_desc: Irin fayilolin da aka amince da su: PDF, JPG, PNG (Kada ya wuce 5 MB).
form.step6_piece_label: 2. Katin makaranta, CNI ko Takaddun haihuwa *
form.step6_piece_hint: Takaddun hukuma na hali na yau da kullun
form.step6_bulletin_label: 3. Rahotanni biyu na makaranta na karshe * (STEAM)
form.step6_autorisation_label: 4. Izinin iyaye da aka sanya hannu * (Karami)
form.step6_autorisation_hint: Takarda da uba, uwa ko mai kula suka sanya hannu
form.step6_preuve_hint: Hoto na samfuri, takardar shaida, labari ko bidiyo
form.step7_desc: Duba cewa dukkan bayananku daidai ne kafin aikawa.
form.step7_cert: Ina tabbatarwa cewa bayanan da na shigar a wannan fom sun yi daidai.
form.step7_cert_desc: Ta hanyar duba wannan akwatin, ina rantsuwa da girmamawa akan gaskiyar dukkan bayanan da aka bayar da cikakken samuwar na don sansanin farko na yanki da sansanin na ƙasa a Agadez a cikin Disambar 2026.
form.step7_cert_parent: Ina tabbatarwa a matsayina na iyaye / mai kula da doka cewa na karanta kuma na amince da wannan neman shiga.
form.step7_cert_parent_desc: Ta hanyar duba wannan akwatin, iyaye ko mai kula da doka yana ba ɗan takarar ƙarami izini don shiga shirin kuma yana tabbatar da daidaiton bayanan da aka bayar.

form.field_classe_placeholder: Misali: Jerin 3, Jerin Biyu C, Jerin Karshe D...

form.field_point_focal_placeholder: Misali: Malam Amadou - Mai gabatarwa Agadez
form.field_bio_placeholder: Gabatar da kanku cikin 'yan layukku: abubuwan sha'awarku, nasarorinku da mafarkin ku na Nijar...
form.submitted_badge: An tura takardar neman shiga cikin nasara!
form.submitted_text: Fayilin neman shigan ku don Camp National Citoyen na Agadez 2026 an rubuta shi.
form.submitted_next_desc: An aika tabbatarwa zuwa imel ɗinku. Kwamitin zaɓe zai duba fayilin ku. Za a sanar da ku ta SMS/Kira don matakin sansanin farko.
